sample_unit: mental health professionals (plus GAI models, 20 runs per block per model)

links.outcome: Change in AI diagnosis/treatment ratings when trauma history was added to otherwise identical vignettes
links.effect: GAI showed some trauma-related diagnostic overshadowing (e.g., PTSD ratings with sexual trauma, P<.001), but bias varied by task and model and was generally less than that of mental health professionals.
links.quote: GAI models demonstrate some evidence of trauma-related diagnostic overshadowing bias, yet the degree of bias varied by task and model.

screen.reason: The study empirically compares frontier LLMs to mental health professionals on clinical decision vignettes to evaluate diagnostic overshadowing bias, but it does not test a specific deployment safeguard or organizational practice.
